lines.en: I got some birthday gifts from the members, they were so cute...
lines.ja: ホロメンから誕生日プレゼントもらったよ もー可愛くてさ

lines.en: The one that I do... There were two specifically that I really want to talk about, and keep some of the others private, but there's two I really want to talk about.
lines.ja: みんなに紹介したいプレゼントが2つあるんだよね 他のやつは内緒にさせてもらうけど

lines.en: First of all is the gift that Ina gave me. She gave me a couple of things,
lines.ja: まずはイナからのプレゼント いろいろくれたんだけど

lines.en: but I'm gonna talk about one specific thing that she gave me.
lines.ja: みんなに話したいやつが1つあってさ

lines.en: That kind of make me laugh out loud.
lines.ja: だってオモロくて…

notes.meaning: 声を出して笑う、爆笑する

lines.en: Oh my god...
lines.ja: ホントに！

lines.en: Okay, so she randomly sent me a LINE message. This was like a couple of days before my birthday.
lines.ja: 誕生日の数日前に いきなりイナからLINEが来たんだよ

notes.meaning: 日本で人気のメッセージアプリ。日本語がそのまま英語配信でも使われる

lines.en: And then she was like... "Random question: Are you good at raising plants? LOL"
lines.ja: 「ベーちゃんってさ 植物のお世話は得意？ｗ」

lines.en: And then I replied with: "Bro, I can't even raise myself."
lines.ja: ボクはこう返した「自分の世話すらできないよ」

lines.en: Um... And then, you know, I realized why, because a part of her present was...
lines.ja: 後になって 質問の理由が分かったよ

lines.en: She gave... She got me a... Sakura bonsai plant!
lines.ja: イナがくれたのは… 桜の盆栽！

notes.meaning: 「盆栽」がそのまま英語の単語として使われている

lines.en: ...That I think I drowned already. I'm not entirely sure.
lines.ja: …水をやりすぎて もう枯らした説あるけど…

lines.en: "Didn't you want to be a florist?"
lines.ja: 「花屋になりたかったんでしょ？」

lines.en: I wanted to put... I wanted to make pretty bouquets! Okay?
lines.ja: いやボクは… ブーケを作りたいだけだし！

lines.en: That's what I wanted to do. It's still... I just wanted to look at pretty flowers!
lines.ja: 育てるっていうか… ただ花を見るのが好きだからだよ！

lines.en: But... she... She wrote me a very sweet card and she was saying, like, You know that...
lines.ja: でもイナはお手紙まで書いてくれてさ

lines.en: She wanted to get me a plant, because it was kind of a reminder of... She wanted to r... She wanted to remind... She wanted to give me a reminder of,
lines.ja: ボクへのプレゼントに 盆栽を選んだのは 木のお世話をきっかけに

lines.en: you know, being... Taking care of myself, every time I took care of the plant
lines.ja: ボクも自分自身のお世話を忘れず 自分のことを大切にできるように…

lines.en: and watching something grow.
lines.ja: …だってさ

lines.en: And I'm just paraphrasing here because it's really sweet and it's gonna make me cry. But...
lines.ja: 読み上げたら泣いちゃいそうだから ざっくりと まとめちゃったけど

notes.meaning: 要約して言い換えること

lines.en: Um... Thank you, Ina.
lines.ja: ありがと、イナ

lines.en: I love...
lines.ja: だいすk…

lines.en: "And then you drown—" Shut up! This is a sentimental moment!
lines.ja: 「でも枯らした」だと！？エモい空気だったのに！

notes.meaning: 感傷的な、しみじみとした

lines.en: I hate you!
lines.ja: ばか！

lines.en: But, I love Ina.
lines.ja: イナ大好き
